class.name: JustAMCPResourceUI
class.brief_description: Serves sandboxed MCP App HTML from [code]ui://[/code] URIs.
class.description: Serves MCP App HTML from [code]ui://.blazium/apps/*.html[/code]. [code]ui://.blazium/apps/host.html[/code] is the embedded module host page; other [code]*.html[/code] names map to [code]res://.blazium/apps/[/code]. Paths containing [code]..[/code] or outside that prefix are rejected.
